scripts.text:
[Exhausted Fairy]
Wait, don't come any closer. I can't stand your smell, it makes me feel dizzy.
scripts.translation:
[疲憊的妖精]
等等，別再靠近了。我受不了你的氣味，聞著就頭暈。

OdesKoUor Ko NuffSharUden Ko CyaVenah An NudNuffser An KoRivehAdor Mu LarseorAnu O DorNe

scripts.text:
[Kalua]
You don't look sophisticated, but I think you are better than those uncivilized guys who are around the snowfield.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧阿]
你看起來不怎麼優雅，不過比雪原上那群野蠻的傢伙好多了。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Flowa]
No offense, I was not looking at you with sympathy.
I just wondered how you could walk with that heavy body...
scripts.translation:
[芙蘿娃]
別誤會，我並不是在同情你。
我只是好奇，你那麼重的身體是怎麼走路的...

[Fairy]
It is shame that I have to
cope with those fat beasts.
I am just too delicate to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
竟然要對付那些肥碩的野獸，真丟臉。
我這麼嬌弱，怎麼和它們打？

mahnarAsh So HirAnMod O Ras

scripts.translation:
[妖精]

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Huh? You are a human.
You are better than those fat Saphas, but still you are not a beautiful thing also.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
咦？你是人類。
雖然比那些肥胖的薩法強，但也談不上漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
How did you find this wonderful place?
This is a sophisticated place.
I don't think you can be here with us.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
你是怎麼找到這麼美妙的地方的？
這裡如此高雅，我可不覺得你適合和我們待在一起。

[Fairy]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Lalalalal~Lala~Lalala~
Let's sing a song~!
My voice is so fantastic!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
啦啦啦啦~啦啦~啦啦啦~
我們來唱歌吧~！
我的歌聲太美妙了！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Don't even think about getting close to me!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
別想靠近我！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
This land was such a waste land.
It was extremely cold and
nothing could live here.
but, once we inhabited this place, it has been changing day by day.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
這裡原本是片荒地，冷得什麼都活不了。
不過，自從我們住進來，這片土地就一天一個樣了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Now, all the problems are gone.
Except those ugly fat Saphas.
How can we be rid of those things?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
現在，所有問題都解決了，只剩那些又醜又胖的薩法。
到底怎樣才能把他們趕走？

[Fairy]
Ah-Ha, I am so stunning.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
啊哈，我真是太迷人了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
AgolWhaNe O LoRini
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
AgolWhaNe O LoRini

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Hey, you~! Human! How did you find us?
What does your human world look like?
Is it fun to be there?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
嘿，你~！人類！你是怎麼找到我們的？
你們人類的世界是什麼樣的？
在那裡生活有趣嗎？

scripts.text:

AnnarNor So marFarAno Di NudThusNei Ir Ir

WhaModKo Or eoNeiNor Di ImanDunah O O
scripts.translation:

[Fairy]
Don't talk to me. What do you want?
I know you will blame something on me right?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
別跟我說話。你想幹什麼？
我知道，你又想把什麼事怪到我頭上，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
I don't want to listen to other people...
I am perfect as I am!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
我才不想聽別人說什麼...
我這樣就已經完美了！

narnahNoh Di WehRiniLars Yee ModAnu

scripts.translation:
[妖精]

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Listen carefully and learn more!
Let's sing and dance!
You can be part of us!
Shake your hips!
Wow~Woo~Wow~
Dance~!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
仔細聽，好好學！
一起唱歌跳舞吧！
你也可以加入我們！
扭起腰來！
哇~嗚~哇~
跳吧~！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
I don't want to touch them at all.
But they are ruining my Yggdrasilberries.
I can't stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
我完全不想碰它們。
但它們正在毀掉我的世界樹漿果。
我再也受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Fighting is not my thing...
But for our glory, I will fight!
They should feel honored to be battling with us!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
打架不是我的強項...
但為了我們的榮耀，我會戰鬥！
能與我們交手，它們應該感到榮幸！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Hu...feel sleepy.
I am so bored. I have nothing to do.
Even my friends are fighting with those giants, but it is not really my job to help them.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
呼...好睏。
真無聊，沒事可做。
朋友們還在和那些巨人打仗，不過幫他們又不是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
I better check my make-up
in the dressing room.
Or should I get more beauty sleep?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
還是去更衣室看看妝容吧。
或者，再睡個美容覺？

[Fairy]
Flying in the sky is not easy.
But it is better than a walk on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
在天空中飛翔並不容易。
但這比在地面上行走要好多了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Are you a human? Poor thing...
You can't have these beautiful wings?
Pathetic lives.
It is obvious that we are the only ones who are blessed.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
你是人類？真可憐...
你沒有這麼漂亮的翅膀吧？可悲的生命。
顯然，只有我們才受到祝福。

Neatness, tidiness and cleanness!
Those are the words.
that can describe us!
Others are so dirty and messy!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
整齊、利落、乾淨！這些詞說的就是我們！
其他人又髒又亂！

[Security Officer]
This is the underground prison of Splendide.
Those who are guilty and prisoners are detained here.
scripts.translation:
[安保人員]
這裡是輝煌領域的地下監獄，關押著罪犯和俘虜。

scripts.text:
[Security Officer]
If you do something suspicious, you must be detained here too, so you'd better to be careful!
scripts.translation:
[安保人員]
做出可疑舉動的話，你也會被關在這裡，最好小心點！

If you make too much noise, the prisoners will cause trouble. So try to keep quiet at all times.
scripts.translation:

請始終保持安靜。

[Voice from another side]
Sir, Please!!!
How can I communicate secretly with Manuk!!
I'm innocent. Please.
scripts.translation:
[來自另一側的聲音]
先生，求求您！我怎麼可能暗中和馬努克聯絡？！
我是無辜的，求求您！

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Hi~~ do you hear the beautiful music coming from afar~?
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
嗨~~ 你聽到從遠處傳來的美妙音樂了嗎~？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Who, me...?
I am just a poet enjoying the ambience...
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
我嗎...？
只是個陶醉於此地氛圍的詩人罷了...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
I cam here the other day, requesting to take notes of this new world and they allow me to follow the adventurers here.
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
前幾天，我申請來記錄這個新世界，獲准跟隨冒險者來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
I became familiar with the Lapine.
It was quite awkward at first... Since I didn't knew their language.
But, one I started to play my instruments... they loved it.
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
我漸漸和拉菲尼熟悉起來了。
起初，因為不懂他們的語言，相處有些尷尬...
可我一奏起樂器，他們就喜歡上了。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
They're fairies that know how to enjoy their lives..
How happy they are...
They are quite curious... I am honored to have met them...
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
他們是懂得享受生活的妖精...多麼快樂啊...
他們充滿好奇心...能認識他們，是我的榮幸...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
So do you want to listen to my playing?
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
那麼，你想聽聽我的演奏嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Not really.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
What song do you want??
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
你想聽哪首曲子？

scripts.text: Poet of Bragie
scripts.translation: 布拉基的詩人

scripts.text: Chaos in Eternity
scripts.translation: 永恆的混沌

scripts.text: Sunset Assassin
scripts.translation: 夕陽刺客

scripts.text: Ring of Nibelungen
scripts.translation: 尼伯龍根的指環

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Poet of Bragie!
You must have a keen ear.
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
布拉基的詩人！
你很懂得欣賞音樂呢。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Chaos in Eternity...
This is a great piece but I wouldn't recommend it while dining...
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
永恆的混沌...
這是一首很棒的曲子，但不建議用餐時聽...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Sunset Assassin!
Do you like Assassins?
This song tells of a legendary Assassin Cross that lived in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
夕陽刺客！
你喜歡刺客嗎？
這首歌講述了一位生活在沙漠中的傳奇十字刺客。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Ring of Nibelungen...
This song has quite an interesting story~
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
尼伯龍根的指環...
這首歌的故事很有趣~

scripts.text:

that would shine as if made of gold.
It's secret hidden from all since
before this story was told...^000000

^4d4dff有一條河名叫萊茵，
閃耀著黃金般的光芒。
早在故事流傳之前，

scripts.text:
^4d4dff Valhalla was born from the goddess Freya.
The envious Rocky destroyed the goddess of beauty.^000000
^4d4dff Out of it's depths was born a ring made of fire.
A ring so strong it held the god's desires~^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff瓦爾哈拉誕生於女神芙蕾雅。
嫉妒的洛基毀滅了美麗的女神。^000000
^4d4dff從深淵中誕生了一枚由火焰鑄成的指環。
一枚強大到能承載眾神慾望的指環~^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dff Alberich's treasure now holds that power.
The power of the ring that held all the god's desires.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff阿爾貝里希的寶藏如今擁有那股力量。
那枚承載眾神慾望的指環的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dff The treasure was used to buy the world's soul.
A soul purchased with the weight of gold.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff寶藏被用來買下世界的靈魂，
以沉甸甸的黃金換來的靈魂。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dff Rocky afraid of losing control. transforms poor Alberich to the shape of a toad.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff洛基唯恐失去控制，將可憐的阿爾貝里希變成了蟾蜍。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff Alberich swears with the last of his breath, that his treasured ring will curse it's wearer till death.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff阿爾貝里希用最後一口氣立誓，他珍愛的指環將詛咒佩戴者，直至死亡。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff Forever will the bearer be, cursed with Rocky's jealousy.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff持有者將永遠被洛基的嫉妒所詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Why not?
Why would you stare at me like that if you didn't want to listen to my playing
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
為什麼不聽？
不想聽我演奏，怎麼還這樣盯著我？

scripts.text: You look like someone I know.
scripts.translation: 你很像我認識的人

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Eh?
No way!
Maybe you're confused..!
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
誒？不可能吧！
你大概認錯人了...！

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Yes, I look quite common...
But I doubt we've ever met before.
scripts.translation:
[詩人 內爾]
是，我的長相是挺普通的...
不過，我們應該沒見過吧。

scripts.text: - Nell seems embarrassed, then starts playing very complicated music -
scripts.translation: - 內爾似乎有些尷尬，然後開始演奏非常複雜的樂曲 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
The poet on the stage is mysterious.
The moment you came here...
He arrived and started playing music.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
舞臺上的詩人很神秘。
你剛來到這裡，他就出現了，開始演奏。

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
This is music from your country yes?
I think it sounds great.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
這是來自你國家的音樂嗎？
我覺得聽起來很棒。

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
IyazLarsSe Or An.
marLoOsa Yee NeiBur
Rinisehrnea Mu...?
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
IyazLarsSe Or An.
marLoOsa Yee NeiBur
Rinisehrnea Mu...?

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
scripts.translation: - 他隨著音樂聲點頭 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
Do you know how to play a similar sound?
This tone is unbelievable.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
你也會演奏這樣的音樂嗎？
這旋律真是不可思議。

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
scripts.translation: - 他隨著音樂聲點頭 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
GothTingNoth Di~ nar..
DiebIyazNud Yu FarAn
nesFarDor U ~
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
GothTingNoth Di~ nar..
DiebIyazNud Yu FarAn
nesFarDor U ~

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
I got bored eating home cooked food.
The only thing that keeps me coming here is fruit soup...
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
家常菜都吃膩了。
只有這裡的水果湯，還能讓我想來...

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
Hey you!
Why are you staring at me eating dinner?
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
嘿，你！幹嗎盯著我吃飯？

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
NothFarLu Ra...? 
RuffYur..!
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
NothFarLu Ra...? 
RuffYur..!

scripts.text: - He is giving me a odd stare as he eats his dinner -
scripts.translation: - 他一邊吃晚餐一邊用奇怪的眼神盯著我 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
We are quite impressed by the poet.
We Laphine love music as well.
I never imagined that I would ever hear such exotic music.
scripts.translation:
[做筆記的拉菲尼]
那位詩人讓我們印象深刻。
我們拉菲尼也熱愛音樂，只是從未想過能聽到這麼富有異域風情的曲子。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
I want to study music someday.
I plan to write much about the study of instruments and music
scripts.translation:
[做筆記的拉菲尼]
以後我想研究音樂，寫下許多關於樂器與音樂的研究心得。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
Someday you should listen to mu people's music.
scripts.translation:
[做筆記的拉菲尼]
有機會，你也該聽聽我們族人的音樂。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
TiTalLars Ur tasThorNoth O AnImanWha.
FusLuRuff..... Mu TingLuAla Yee AnmanAndu
scripts.translation:
[做筆記的拉菲尼]
TiTalLars Ur tasThorNoth O AnImanWha.
FusLuRuff..... Mu TingLuAla Yee AnmanAndu

scripts.text: - He seems frustrated that you don't understand him -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎很沮喪，因為你聽不懂他的話 -

scripts.text: - He is almost sleeping but he is still managing to hold a cup with a drink in it. He must be really tired-
scripts.translation: - 他幾乎睡著了，但手裡還緊緊握著一杯飲料。他一定累壞了 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You are a stranger here, aren't you?
I am watching him to prevent anything bad from happening.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你是外來者吧？
我正盯著他，免得出什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Definitely you are involved.
The upper side people allow you to pass here...
But nobody knows what's going to happen in this battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你肯定也脫不了關係。
雖然上頭允許你們來這裡，但這可是戰場，誰也不知道會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Anyway, what's that instrument over there?
We have a similar one...
But it sounds totally different.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
總之，那邊那個樂器是什麼？
我們也有類似的...
但聽起來完全不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
FusVohlAnu Ur Lon.
LoUdenFar Ha Dormaur?
...marAmanYur Mu.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
FusVohlAnu Ur Lon.
LoUdenFar Ha Dormaur?
...marAmanYur Mu.

scripts.text: -The Laphine Soldier wants to tell you something, but just stops talking as you give him a blank stare -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼士兵想告訴你些什麼，但當你一臉茫然地看著他時，他就閉嘴了 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
Hm, what's up?
I'm sorry, but we don't sell food to strangers.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
嗯，怎麼了？
抱歉，我們不向陌生人出售食物。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
You guys also need to be careful of food here.
Food is scarce here.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
你們在這裡也得省著點吃，食物很緊缺。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
You're going to have to find food somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
你們得去別的地方找食物了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
VeldAnoWeh Or 
TurWos
......ah...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
VeldAnoWeh Or 
TurWos
......ah...

scripts.text: - You just grin and smile. It's frustrating not to be able to understand their language. -
scripts.translation: - 你只是咧嘴一笑。聽不懂他們的語言真讓人沮喪。 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
his camp serves a military purpose. But we also have a need for bars.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
這裡雖然是軍事營地，但我們也需要酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
How else can a soldier release stress if not through drinking...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
士兵如果不喝酒，還能怎麼釋放壓力呢...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
We are here to support the laphine soldier by giving good drinks and entertainment.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
我們提供美酒和娛樂，為拉菲尼士兵服務。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
NorVerNuff Ee Re!
remuDurOdes Mu AshFus~!
OdesTalWeh Ur???
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼職員]
NorVerNuff Ee Re!
remuDurOdes Mu AshFus~!
OdesTalWeh Ur???

scripts.text:
[High-Ranked Soldier]
Are there any new supplies?
scripts.translation:
[高階士兵]
有新到的補給品嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
This sword just arrived...
This is inspired by stars, and we tested it by cutting the thread floating over the water.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
這把劍剛送來...
設計靈感來自星辰，我們用它切斷浮在水面上的絲線，試了試鋒利程度。

scripts.text:
[High-Ranked Soldier]
Hmm, we rarely used swords. But it looks great as a decoration.
scripts.translation:
[高階士兵]
嗯，我們很少用劍。但作為裝飾品看起來很不錯。

scripts.text: - Seems their busy talking about weapons -
scripts.translation: - 他們似乎在談論武器 -
